events.title: El Cid routs an Almoravid army at the Battle of Cuarte
events.description: Months after El Cid captured Valencia, an Almoravid army under Muhammad ibn Tashfin, sent to recover the city, camped on the plain of Cuarte. El Cid sallied out and routed it, the first major defeat of the Almoravids in the Iberian Peninsula.

events.title: Seljuk Turks destroy the People's Crusade at Civetot
events.description: The undisciplined People's Crusade, inspired by Peter the Hermit, was ambushed and annihilated by Seljuk forces near Civetot in Anatolia. On its way east, the movement had massacred Jewish communities in the Rhineland.

events.title: The First Crusade reaches Antioch and begins its siege
events.description: A day after forcing the Iron Bridge over the Orontes, the First Crusade reached Antioch, Bohemond of Taranto leading the vanguard. Bohemond, Raymond IV of Toulouse and Godfrey of Bouillon took positions at different gates for a siege of nine months.

events.title: The Earl of Derby defeats a larger French army at Auberoche
events.description: In the Gascon campaign of the Hundred Years' War, an Anglo-Gascon force of 1,200 under Henry, Earl of Derby, heavily defeated a French army of 7,000 under Louis of Poitiers at Auberoche, near Périgueux. The French leaders were killed or captured.

events.title: Tokugawa Ieyasu wins the Battle of Sekigahara
events.description: Tokugawa Ieyasu defeated a coalition of western lords at Sekigahara, helped by defections mid-battle. The victory led to the Tokugawa shogunate, which ruled a largely peaceful Japan for more than 250 years.

events.title: Nelson defeats the French and Spanish fleets at Trafalgar
events.description: Admiral Horatio Nelson's fleet destroyed the combined French and Spanish fleets off Cape Trafalgar, ending Napoleon's hopes of invading Britain. Nelson was mortally wounded by a musket ball during the battle.

events.title: Edison's carbon-filament lamp begins a 13-hour test
events.description: At Menlo Park, Thomas Edison's team lit a bulb with a carbonised cotton-thread filament that glowed for about 13.5 hours. The result made long-lasting electric lighting practical.

events.title: A colliery spoil tip engulfs a school at Aberfan
events.description: A coal waste tip slid down onto the Welsh village of Aberfan, burying Pantglas Junior School. The disaster killed 144 people, 116 of them children, and an inquiry blamed the National Coal Board.
